gate.title: Noise Gate
gate.subtitle: Kills hum and hiss before anything downstream amplifies it
gate.input_hint: Input level. Play your loudest chord and back the interface gain off until the bar stops turning red.
gate.body: With the gate engaged, everything quieter than the guitar itself gets shut out between notes: single-coil hum, amp hiss, the fridge. High-gain tones want it in; clean tones usually do not.

cab.title: Cabinet
cab.subtitle: Speaker and microphone — the last thing that shapes the tone
cab.replaced: Replaced by the loaded impulse response

amp.subtitle_nam: Neural capture of a real head, in place of the preamp and tone stack
amp.subtitle_classic: Cascading preamp, passive tone stack and power section
amp.no_captures: No captures loaded yet — the classic channel is running instead.
amp.classic_hint: Preamp is the first gain stage, ahead of the tone stack. Drive pushes the power section after it — the two cascade, so a little of each sounds different from all of one.

presets.save_as_hint: Save the current settings as a new preset

status.choose_hint: Choose the audio interface, channels and buffer size
status.buffer_hint: Frames per audio callback — smaller is tighter but more fragile
status.dropouts_hint: Hardware callbacks that found nothing to play since the stream opened — each one was an audible gap. Dropped blocks are the engine shedding backlog to keep latency from creeping up.
status.dsp_hint: Share of each audio block spent inside the chain

settings.input_channel_hint: Which input channel to capture from — e.g. the guitar jack on a multi-channel interface
settings.asio_same_device: ASIO uses the same device for input and output
settings.output_channel_hint: First output channel to monitor through — e.g. outputs 3/4 instead of 1/2 on a multi-channel interface
settings.buffer_title: ASIO/WASAPI buffer size — smaller = lower latency but more prone to crackling
settings.buffer_hint: Smaller buffers cut latency; too small and the audio starts crackling.

view.audio_hint: Audio interface, channels and buffer size
view.no_connection: No connection to the desktop app — this is a visual preview only, audio control is inactive.
view.overload: The DSP chain fell behind real time and had to reset (~{{drift}}ms drift) — you probably just heard a click.
view.overload_nam_hint: Try a bigger buffer or a lighter capture.
view.overload_vst_hint: Try a bigger buffer — the plugin needs more time per block.

amp_button.title: Amp simulator (ASIO, live)
amp_button.builtin_readonly: Built-in presets are read-only — save your changes as a new one
amp_button.overload: DSP fell behind and reset (~{{drift}}ms) — you may have heard a click.
amp_button.overload_nam_hint: A lighter NAM model or a safer latency setting helps.
amp_button.dropouts_detected: Dropouts detected — try a safer latency setting.
amp_button.overload_vst_hint: A safer latency setting gives the plugin more time per block.
amp_button.vst_rack_empty: No plugins yet — build the rack in Tone Studio.

mode.choose_title: How do you want to shape your sound?
mode.choose_hint: You can switch any time from the top bar.
mode.builtin_body: Gate, overdrive, amp, cabinet and delay — with ready presets and NAM captures.
mode.vst_body: Build a rack from the plugins on this computer — Neural DSP, iZotope, NAM — in any order you like.

rack_vst.title: Rack
rack_vst.empty_body: Pick plugins from your library below — the guitar runs through them left to right.
rack_vst.unsupported: VST plugins aren't available on this computer.

library.title: Plugin library
library.first_title: Find the plugins on this computer
library.first_body: riff.quest looks through the standard VST3 folder. The first scan can take a minute — plugins without a licence are skipped.
library.scan_rest: Scan this computer for the rest
library.none_found: No VST3 effects found. Add a plugin file or a folder you keep them in.
